summary: Bug Fix Verified: Creator episode upload feature working correctly. The new endpoint POST /api/creator/series/{series_id}/episodes was added to fix the 'Not Found' error when creators tried to upload videos using batch upload. Full flow tested: user registration (via curl) → creator application → admin approval → series creation → episode creation via new endpoint → video upload. All 3 test episodes (S01E01, S01E02, S01E03) created successfully and visible in frontend.

minor.issue: Blocks automated requests with 'Automated requests are not allowed' - limits automated testing

tests.details: Shows all 3 episodes with correct codes
S01E01, S01E02, S01E03 all displayed with correct badges

critical_code_review_comments: The fix correctly adds POST /api/creator/series/{series_id}/episodes endpoint to match frontend expectations
Response structure includes both 'episode' object (for frontend) and flat 'episode_id', 'episode_code' fields (backward compatibility)
Bunny.net integration working - video placeholders created and uploads processed
seed_data_creation: Created test series 'Test Upload Fix Series' with 3 episodes (S01E01, S01E02, S01E03) via API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creator episode upload bug has been fixed. New endpoint POST /api/creator/series/{series_id}/episodes is working. Test series 'Test Upload Fix Series' (cs-25a5e436d9) exists with 3 episodes. Admin account (superadmin@kona.com) is now also an approved creator (creator-4990f037d11b).

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Episode upload feature was failing with 'Not Found' error when creators tried to upload videos using the batch upload feature
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Frontend batch upload code was calling POST /api/creator/series/{series_id}/episodes but backend only had POST /api/creator/episodes (which requires series_id in body)
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added new endpoint POST /api/creator/series/{series_id}/episodes to match frontend expectations
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Successfully created 3 episodes via the new endpoint, verified in frontend UI
